versions.content: If the configuration parameter NmSynchronizingNetwork is FALSE for all of the presently awake busses in a coordination cluster, the timers shall be started after all shutdown conditions have been met, without waiting for a call to Nm_SynchronizationPoint (). (see also [SWS_Nm_00172]).

If the configuration parameter NmSynchronizingNetwork is FALSE for all of the presently awake busses in a coordination cluster, the timers shall be started after all shutdown conditions have been met, without waiting for a call to Nm_SynchronizationPoint (). (see also [SWS_Nm_00172]).

If the configuration parameter NmSynchronizingNetwork is FALSE for all of the presently awake busses in a coordination cluster, the timers shall be started after all shutdown conditions have been met, without waiting for a call to Nm_SynchronizationPoint (). (see also [SWS_Nm_00172]).

If the configuration parameter NmSynchronizingNetwork is FALSE for all of the presently awake busses in a coordination cluster, the timers shall be started after all shutdown conditions have been met, without waiting for a call to Nm_SynchronizationPoint (). (see also [SWS_Nm_00172]).
